newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian M2 money supply 2.9 pct up in August.
newsitem.headline: Romanian M2 money supply 2.9 pct up in August.

text.p: Romania's M2 money supply expanded by 2.9 in August from July, but the rise was below the 3.8 percent monthly inflation and influenced by sesonal trends, the central bank (BNR) said on Tuesday.
Broad money went up by a year-on-year 65.1 percent in August, when it was 27.1 percent up from last December.

The BNR said M1 narrow money, which includes currency outside banks and demand deposits, rose by 3.0 percent to 8.1 trillion lei at end-August, with cash in circulation surging by 4.3 percent to 4.1 trillion lei, a BNR report said.

It said household savings saw a modest 2.2 percent rise to 7.3 trillion lei under the impact of inflationary expectations and summer holidays, which had already pushed higher the currency outside banks.
The trade balance deficit weighed havily on residents' forex deposits which stayed flat at July's level of $1.6 billion, the BNR said. They took 22.3 percent of end-August broad money.
ROMANIAN MONEY SUPPLY AUGUST JULY AUGUST 95
